verdict.rationale: Workers' own docs state that it can schedule cron jobs, which is a recurring schedule rather than a one-off action. It can also run durable Workflows that chain steps, retry failures and persist state for weeks. The Agents SDK lists built-in scheduling, and a community user reports enjoying Workflows. Missing for 10: detailed docs on cron trigger syntax and frequency limits, and independent hands-on corroboration of recurring cron runs specifically.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows

citations.quote: Schedule cron jobs, run durable Workflows, and integrate with Queues
you can build applications that chain together multiple steps, automatically retry failed tasks, and persist state for minutes, hours, or even weeks - with no infrastructure to manage
Each agent has its own state, storage, and lifecycle — with built-in support for real-time communication, scheduling, AI model calls, MCP, workflows, and more.
